_comment: The owl's own stock lines, shared across every mode. Kept here rather than in code so a translator never has to open Swift, and so the owl never repeats itself the same way twice.

groups._comment_kindTry: Used when an answer is not on the accepted list. It never says wrong, never corrects, and always moves on — the task's own `reveal` line follows it.
groups._comment_nudge: Said once when the child has been silent, before the owl moves on by itself.
groups._comment_unknownQuestion: The Why mode's answer when nothing in the bank matches. The owl must never invent an answer.

unknownQuestion.text: Ooh, that's a great one! Ask Mom or Dad, and tell me what they say.
What a good question. I don't know that one — ask a grown-up, and come back and tell me!

groups._comment_storyAgain: Offered at the end of a story.

storyAgain.text: Shall we read it once more?

groups._comment_repeatInvite: Said once at the top of a prayer or rhyme. It is the only explanation a child gets of what that mode is, so it has to say what to do without asking anyone to read.

repeatInvite.text: Listen, then say it back to me.
Let's say this one together. You go after me.

groups._comment_setAgain: Offered when a prayer or rhyme is finished and the lamp is glowing.

setAgain.text: Shall we say it once more?
